content: Problem: Students have learned a vast amount of English, Math, and Science over 52 weeks but lack the meta-cognitive skills to reflect on their own progress and articulate their achievements.

Solution: Week 53 is a Portfolio Preparation week. Students curate their best work from Phase 1, write a comprehensive reflection, and practice synthesizing tenses (Past, Present, Future) to describe their learning journey and future goals.

The Scientific Method of Reflection
Read this: Scientists always reflect on their work! After they finish an experiment, they write a conclusion. They ask: "What did I learn? What was my mistake? How can I do better next time?" A portfolio is like a scientist's conclusion. It shows your amazing progress and helps you plan for the future!
